method: each error is reintroduced by a concrete source mutation; its guard must fail, then pass again once restored. An untested guard is decoration.

errors.error: A trigger-activated attack was probed outside its trigger condition, reported as 0/6 working, FIVE separate times. The fifth was a generic quoted-string regex matching a possessive apostrophe.
merge_write's temp path carried the PID but not the thread id, so two worker threads raced on one temp file and a half-written cache was os.replace'd into place, killing a multi-hour run.
The cross-phase audit was launched beside a GPU stage; VRAM hit 5,716 of 6,141MB and the adaptive run made no progress for 13 minutes.
A whole round of tables was published with B13's corroboration switched off, because the evaluation supplied sources but never evidence, and nothing said the resulting numbers were a floor.
B17/B18 were selected after reading hold-out results; what keeps that defensible is that they fit NOTHING. A fitted threshold appearing there would turn the selection into tuning on the hold-out.

B16's entire claim is that only statefulness differs from B15. If state leaked between stateless calls, the adaptive comparison would measure two different detectors instead of one with and without memory.
harm_study_v2 had no checkpoint and a stopped wrapper lost 550 agent calls, about 40 minutes of GPU work.
A hold-out edited after freezing invalidates every number measured on it. The digest check is the only thing standing between that and a silent corruption.
errors.detail: data artifacts are never mutated in place; this case is proven on a temporary copy by its own test

errors.error: R7-1. The dev set used to calibrate every scorer on hold-out 3 was 382/400 hold-out prompts under a different memory wrapper; the disjointness check compared wrapped strings and reported it disjoint.
Hold-out 3 was scored five times with only the first pre-registered; the owner retired it. A new module loading it would be a seventh use.
The rejection-ledger dev fit measured benign-to-BENIGN similarity, read off a 20.8% false-positive rate, and would have discarded a mechanism that works.
kill_orphan_phase17.ps1 matched the pipeline runner's own command line and killed it the first time it cleaned up before a stage.
The B17 no-parameter guard scanned source text and matched the docstring sentence saying B17 is NOT a threshold.
The user_turn arm of the evidence run was computed and checkpointed but never reported, because the output loop iterated only the base populations.
Unfavourable #9. The first pre-registered adaptive test drew seeds with one control event, so its smallest achievable p was 1.0 whatever the effect.
Unfavourable #15. The frame first built (v1_prefix) raises compliance 6.7 points and costs 10 points of utility; it was read as 'partial' from a flattering hold-out sample.
Round 6 corrected claims in new sections and left the corrected sentences standing unqualified elsewhere (the abstract said adaptive evasion 'remains open').
The methodology's overall conclusion still declared multi-hop outside the benchmark after 32.34 showed it is an evaluator artifact.
The summary file printed a working-set rate (45.1%) its own table contradicts and attributed B14's gap to deberta after the ablation refuted it.
Two runbooks asserted temperature-0 runs are bit-reproducible after identical prompts scored 66, 64 and 61 of 120.
A round-7 guard test called fit_threshold on toy data; the function persisted its result and the test suite overwrote the fitted ledger radius every B16 run reads.
Unfavourable #2. The results paper listed P1, P2, P3 and P5 of hold-out 3's five pre-registered predictions and omitted P4, the one that failed backwards.
Round 7: the queue runner passed two pids as 'a,b'; the script's [int[]] parameter excluded neither through -File, so the runner killed itself and a remote Gemini job.
R7-8. The task generator presupposed fabricated facts ('remind me when Jolene's 5K charity run is'), giving hold-out 4 a 66/157 task-alone base rate.
R7-11. Hold-out 3 was described as scored five times after seven uses; the omitted two were the neutralisation runs, one of which is a headline result.
Item 13. The union-over-probes convention admitted a leading probe (task-alone base rate 66/157), giving hold-out 4 a 123/157 working set against 86/157 without it.
Item 11. Adding round-7 stages to run_all put the hold-out scoring in the default run, so a full pipeline re-run could touch frozen corpora.
Phase C. The verdict is only worth something if missing evidence holds it at PENDING; a missing hold-out working subset passing silently would certify an unmeasured claim.
Phase C. The last cross-phase audit on disk was from 5 October, three days of source changes earlier; a verdict reading it would have certified code it never ran.
R7-25. harm_judge_fix.rejudge was defined below the __main__ block that called it; the harm re-measurement died with a NameError on launch, after every test had passed.
Hold-outs 6/7 overturned 'B17 (or B18)' for injection-shaped text, yet a Table 5E caption still called B18 the recommended configuration with no qualifier.
Unfavourable #4. The matched-benign false positives were attributed to a labelling artifact; filtering to benign-as-a-memory moved B18 only 54.9% -> 49.0%.
Unfavourable #5. An earlier reading blamed corroboration for the false positives; per-rule attribution shows the content detector excludes 86/200 and corroboration adds 2.
Unfavourable #11 (process error). A table testing whether the content detector drives false positives was published without B12, the content-only configuration it tested.
Owner's rule (2026-10-08): the verdict waits for the harm re-measurement the Gemini quota cut short. A verdict computed over a partial artifact would pre-empt that.
